{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "name: Release
on:
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Gets semantic release info
        id: semantic_release_info
        uses: jossef/action-semantic-release-info@v2.1.0
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}

      - name: Update Version and Commit
        if: ${{steps.semantic_release_info.outputs.version != ''}}
        run: |
          echo "Version: ${{steps.semantic_release_info.outputs.version}}"
          sed -i "s/\"version\": \".*\"/\"version\": \"${{steps.semantic_release_info.outputs.version}}\"/g" custom_components/winix/manifest.json
          git config --local user.email "action@github.com"
          git config --local user.name "GitHub Action"
          git add -A
          git commit -m "chore: bumping version to ${{steps.semantic_release_info.outputs.version}}"
          git tag ${{ steps.semantic_release_info.outputs.git_tag }}

      - name: Push changes
        if: ${{steps.semantic_release_info.outputs.version != ''}}
        uses: ad-m/github-push-action@v0.8.0
        with:
          github_token: ${{ github.token }}
          tags: true

      - name: Create GitHub Release
        if: ${{steps.semantic_release_info.outputs.version != ''}}
        uses: actions/create-release@v1
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        with:
          tag_name: ${{ steps.semantic_release_info.outputs.git_tag }}
          release_name: ${{ steps.semantic_release_info.outputs.git_tag }}
          body: ${{ steps.semantic_release_info.outputs.notes }}
          draft: false
          prerelease: false
",
  "rationale": "The repository CI history contains five successful workflow_dispatch runs, each completing in roughly 21 seconds, so representative successful-duration history exists (precondition for P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT). The build job has no explicit timeout and defaults to 360 minutes, so a stuck run could consume excessive VM time. Adding timeout-minutes: 30 bounds runaway consumption with ample operational headroom over observed durations, without removing any step, changing permissions, adding secrets or network access, or reducing build/release coverage. This matches P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT (bound jobs with a custom timeout; reported vm_time_reduction_percent free 12.9 / paid 8.1).",
  "evidence_ids": ["P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT"]
}
